'''Caramanta''' is an extinct [[Chocoan language]] of [[Colombia]], documented solely through a wordlist from the 1940s,<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Arcila Velez |first=Graciliano |date=1946 |title=Los Caramanta |journal=Revista Universidad de Antioquia |volume=XX |pages=445–452}}</ref> and in an ethnographic publication from 1954.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Daniel |first=H. |date=1954 |title=Apuntes etnológicos: Los Caramantas |journal=Boletin del Instituto de Antropología |volume=1 |issue=2 |pages=171–180|url=https://revistas.udea.edu.co/index.php/boletin/article/download/341339/20795846/187699 }}</ref> It is sometimes described as a dialect of [[Anserma language|Anserma]].<ref name="e25">{{Ethnologue25|crf|Caramanta}}</ref>
